info.name: Lavrel backend
info.description: Fill the collection variables firebaseApiKey, email and password (Current value column), then run request 1 first.

request.description: Run this first. It saves the Firebase ID token into the idToken collection variable. The token expires after about an hour: run this request again when you get 401. If the account's e-mail is not verified yet, every endpoint except 2 answers 403 email_not_verified: for a test address that cannot receive mail, run 26 once, then run this request again to get a token with email_verified = true.

item.name: 2. Current user (own profile: publicId, username, e-mail, emailVerified, role, country)

exec: pm.test("Has emailVerified and role", function () { pm.expect(me.emailVerified).to.be.a("boolean"); pm.expect(me.role).to.be.oneOf(["USER", "SUPPORT", "ADMIN"]); });
if (!me.emailVerified) { console.log("E-mail not verified: every other endpoint will answer 403 email_not_verified."); }

item.name: 7. List linked accounts (saves platform + externalId; shows lastSyncedAt)

exec: pm.test("No database ids exposed", function () { accounts.forEach(a => pm.expect(a).to.not.have.property("id")); });

item.name: 8. Sync linked account (can take a minute; run again while gamesPending > 0)

request.description: Run 7 first: it saves the account's platform and external id (SteamID64). The database id is never used in URLs.

item.name: 11. Start Steam link (open redirectUrl in a browser)

exec: console.log("Open this URL in your browser:", pm.response.json().redirectUrl);

request.description: Copy redirectUrl from the response and open it in a browser. Log in at Steam; the browser returns to the backend callback. The path is /accounts/{platform}/link: steam works today, xbox and psn once their adapters exist (see 22).

item.name: 12. Admin: seed catalog from Steam (top 100 most played)

request.description: Admin only (your UID in ADMIN_FIREBASE_UIDS). Imports the most played Steam games with their achievements and descriptions. Slow on purpose (a pause between Steam calls): expect a few minutes. Known games and known failures cost no Steam call, so it is safe to run again.

item.name: 13. Admin: seed catalog with specific Steam app ids

request.description: Use this if the most-played chart is unavailable.
Creates fake users (firebase_uid starting with fake-), each with a Steam account, random games from the catalog and random unlocks. Seed the catalog first.

item.name: 16. Game details (description, tags, creators, features, ratings)
17. Admin: seed NEXT batch of Steam games (run in the Collection Runner)

exec: console.log("attempted " + r.attempted + " | imported " + r.imported + " | already known " + r.alreadyKnown
+ " | skipped (remembered) " + r.skippedKnownFailures + " | next cursor " + r.nextCursor + " | more: " + r.hasMore);
if (!r.hasMore) { console.log("Reached the end of the Steam game list."); postman.setNextRequest(null); }
if (r.stoppedEarly) { console.log("Steam stopped answering; cursor kept. Run again later."); postman.setNextRequest(null); }

request.description: Walks Steam's full game list in appid order and imports up to `limit` games that have achievements. The script stores nextCursor in the seedCursor variable, so each run continues where the last one stopped. To let it run unattended: Runner -> select ONLY this request -> Iterations 20 -> Delay 5000 ms -> Run. The run stops by itself at the end of the list or if Steam stops answering.

item.name: 18. Reset the seed cursor to 0 (start the walk over)

request.description: Only sets seedCursor back to 0. Starting over is cheap: games already imported and apps already rejected cost no Steam calls.

item.name: 19. Admin: enrich existing games with details / remove adult content (run in the Collection Runner)

exec: console.log("checked " + r.checked + " | removed " + r.removed + " | still pending " + r.remaining);
if (r.remaining === 0) { console.log("All games are enriched."); postman.setNextRequest(null); }
if (r.stoppedEarly) { console.log("Steam stopped answering. Run again later."); postman.setNextRequest(null); }

request.description: Games imported before the details existed are hidden until enriched. Each call takes up to `limit` of them: one batched call fetches their tags, creators, reviews and categories, then one store-page call per game. Safe games get their details and are published; adult ones (judged by tags with weights, age rating, descriptors) and games Steam no longer knows are removed with their achievements and unlocks. Runner -> select ONLY this request -> Iterations 20 -> Delay 3000 ms. It stops by itself when nothing is pending.

item.name: 20. Admin: refresh game details from Steam - manual sync (run in the Collection Runner)

exec: console.log("refreshed " + r.refreshed + " | removed " + r.removed + " | still due " + r.remaining);
if (r.remaining === 0) { console.log("Everything is up to date."); postman.setNextRequest(null); }
if (r.stoppedEarly) { console.log("Steam stopped answering. Run again later."); postman.setNextRequest(null); }

request.description: Re-copies tags, genres and details from Steam for published games. Tags and genres never change on their own: only this call changes them. Games stay visible while they are refreshed; a game that no longer passes the content policy is removed. With olderThanDays it takes the games not refreshed in that time (or never: right after migration V10 that is every game, so run it once to fill the genres). Send {"appIds": ["292030"]} instead to refresh specific games. Set refreshTagNames to true to also replace the stored tag names. Runner -> select ONLY this request -> Iterations 20 -> Delay 3000 ms. It stops by itself when nothing is due.

A free display name: 2-32 characters, letters of any alphabet, digits, spaces and _ . - ' ! ? & # ( ) [ ]. Not unique (people are told apart by publicId). Names posing as staff (admin, support, lavrel...) are rejected with 400 invalid_username.
Xbox is a known platform but has no identity adapter yet. Once an Xbox adapter exists, this returns 200 with a redirectUrl, like request 11.
Platform names in URLs are steam, xbox or psn (any case). Anything else is rejected before reaching the use case.

item.name: 24. Admin: invalid seed body (expect 400 validation_failed with details)

exec: pm.test("One problem per invalid field", function () { pm.expect(details.map(d => d.field)).to.include.members(["limit", "appIds[0]"]); });

request.description: limit must be 1-200 and app ids numeric. Before the validation pass these were clamped or skipped silently; now the whole request is rejected and nothing is imported.

item.name: 25. Platform callback without a state (expect 400, or 302 with a frontend)

exec: pm.test("Rejected: 400 JSON, or 302 to the frontend error page", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.oneOf([400, 302]); });
if (pm.response.code === 400) { pm.test("Error code is invalid_identity_proof", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().error).to.eql("invalid_identity_proof"); }); }

request.description: The new generic callback path (public: platforms redirect the browser here without our token). Without the signed state the link is refused. With app.frontend.base-url set, the browser is redirected to {base}/steam/linked?status=error instead. /api/steam/callback still works the same.

item.name: 26. DEV (run once, right after 1): mark my test e-mail as verified

exec: if (pm.response.code === 200) { console.log("Done. Run request 1 again to get a token with email_verified = true."); }
if (pm.response.code === 404) { console.log("Not enabled for this account: set app.dev.verify-email-uids to its Firebase UID and restart."); }

request.description: For test accounts whose e-mail cannot receive the verification link. Only exists while app.dev.verify-email-uids is set, only works for the Firebase UIDs listed there and only on your own account, and refuses (409) once the e-mail is verified. Steps: set the property to your UID, restart, run 1, run this, run 1 again, then remove the property and restart.

Roles: USER, SUPPORT, ADMIN. Set the targetPublicId variable to the user's publicId (request 2 shows yours). Changing your own role is refused with 400 invalid_role_change. The first admin is promoted in the database: UPDATE users SET role = 'ADMIN' WHERE firebase_uid = '<your UID>';

exec: pm.test("Marvel Rivals exempted or imported", function () { pm.expect(results[0].status).to.be.oneOf(["EXEMPTED", "IMPORTED"]); });

request.description: Lets games the content policy would reject into the catalog. Marvel Rivals (2767030) has the Hentai and Sexual Content tags with enough weight to be rejected. Per app: EXEMPTED (already in the catalog, now flagged), IMPORTED (imported now without the policy), NOT_IMPORTABLE (still not a catalog game, e.g. no achievements; see reason) or DEFERRED (Steam unreachable, try again). Exempt games are never removed by enrich or refresh for content reasons.

exec: pm.test("Removed (204) or not in the catalog (404)", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.oneOf([204, 404]); });

request.description: The game stays for now; the next refresh judges it by the content policy again (and removes it if it fails). Run 28 again to restore the exception.

item.name: 31. Tracking: track a game (or change its status)

request.description: Status: PLAYING, BACKLOG, COMPLETED or DROPPED. Any catalog game can be tracked (synced games are in the catalog). Set the trackGameId variable to a game id.
sort: release (default, newest store release first), title or updated. Each card has progress and the 3 easiest locked achievements.
Also takes it out of quick access. Run 31 again to add it back.

item.name: 35. Quick access: pin a tracked game

request.description: Pins at the end. At most 20 games: the 21st answers 409 quick_access_full. The game must be tracked first (31).
List every pinned game exactly once, in the new order; anything else is 400 invalid_quick_access_order.
The game stays in the tracking list.

exec: pm.test("Has games and hasMore", function () { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.games).to.be.an("array"); pm.expect(j.hasMore).to.be.a("boolean"); });

request.description: No login needed. sort: relevance (default with q), popular (default without q), rating, newest, name. page from 0, size up to 50.

item.name: 40. Search: by name with a typo

request.description: Typo tolerant and accent insensitive: 'witcer' finds The Witcher, 'pokemon' finds Pokémon.
Take a tag id from 43. Several tags (tag=1,2) and modes must ALL apply. Also franchise=, developer=, publisher= with ids from 44.

exec: pm.test("Grouped results", function () { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j).to.have.all.keys("games", "tags", "franchises"); });

request.description: 5 games, 5 tags and 3 franchises for the header dropdown. q needs at least 2 characters.

exec: if (tags.length > 0) { pm.collectionVariables.set("searchTagId", String(tags[0].id)); console.log("searchTagId =", tags[0].id, tags[0].name); }

request.description: Saves the first tag's id as searchTagId for request 41. q is optional (without it: most used tags).
role: franchise, developer or publisher. Use the id in /api/games?franchise={id}.

item.name: 45. My library (recently played first; saves libraryGameId)

request.description: Your owned games (all linked accounts) with cover, progress, playtime and which accounts own them. sort: recent (default), name, playtime, progress, newest. Same filters as search: q, tag, mode; plus collection.
1-40 characters, unique per user ignoring case (409 collection_name_taken), up to 50 collections.

item.name: 49. Collections: add a game I own

request.description: Only games in your library (run 45 first): anything else answers 422 game_not_owned.
Deletes the collection only; the games stay in your library.

exec: pm.test("No personal data without a token", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().unlocked).to.eql(null); });

request.description: Anyone: the list with worldwide percentages. Hidden ones come with hidden: true, to blur in the UI.
With your token: unlocked / unlockedAt per achievement and the percentage in your country.

item.name: 56. Firebase: send me the verification e-mail

exec: if (pm.response.code === 200) { console.log("Verification e-mail sent to", pm.response.json().email, "- open the link, then run request 1 again."); }

request.description: Firebase sends its verification link to the e-mail of the account signed in with request 1 (a real mailbox: check spam too). After clicking it, run request 1 again: the new token has email_verified = true. Talks to Firebase directly, not to our backend, so it works in production.

item.name: 57. Firebase: send me a password-reset e-mail

exec: if (pm.response.code === 200) { console.log("Password-reset e-mail sent to", pm.response.json().email); } else { console.log(pm.response.json()); }

request.description: Sends Firebase's password-reset link to {{email}}. Useful for an account created with Google: setting a password through this link lets request 1 sign in to the same account (same Firebase UID) with e-mail and password.
Run 7 first. The account's games leave your library and the unlocks recorded from it are removed; tracked games and collections stay. Link (11) and sync (8) again to bring everything back.
Safety check: without ?confirm=true nothing is deleted.

item.name: 60. DANGER - delete my account for good

request.description: DELETES THE SIGNED-IN ACCOUNT FOR GOOD: our data (accounts, library, unlocks, tracking list, collections) and the Firebase sign-in account. Only use it with a throwaway test account; never include it in a Collection Runner run. The only admin gets 409 last_admin.

item.name: 61. Admin: mark a game as available on PlayStation

request.description: Systems: pc, xbox, playstation. PC comes automatically for Steam games; Xbox and PlayStation are set here for now. Then request 16 shows availableOn.

exec: pm.test("Every card is on PlayStation", function () { pm.response.json().games.forEach(g => pm.expect(g.availableOn).to.include("PLAYSTATION")); });

request.description: Several systems (system=pc&system=xbox) must all apply.
Removing PC from a Steam game only lasts until its next refresh.
On by default: every few hours your accounts are synced, reading only games played since the last sync.

item.name: 65. Automatic sync: turn it off / on

request.description: Set enabled back to true to turn it on again.
Everything is private by default.

item.name: 67. Profile: make it public (with country, badges and picture)

request.description: Any subset of the fields. Platform badges only say which platforms; never account names or ids.
Types: COLLECTION (needs collectionId), RECENTLY_PLAYED, PLAYING, COMPLETED, ACHIEVEMENTS, STATS. Up to 10 shelves.

item.name: 69. Shelves: add a RECENTLY_PLAYED shelf with a title
70. Shelves: add an ACHIEVEMENTS shelf (saves shelfId)
71. Shelves: pick the achievements to show

request.description: Run 55 first (it saves one of your unlocked achievements). Up to 12, only ones you unlocked.
What anyone sees: header plus the shelves, already filled. A private profile answers 404 profile_not_found.
By name (2+ characters) or an exact 16-digit public id. Only public profiles.

item.name: 76. Avatars: pick one from the gallery

request.description: Body tab: choose a JPG, PNG or GIF file (up to 2 MB; GIFs up to 1 MB and 512x512, animation kept). Set the Content-Type header to match. Needs SUPABASE_URL and SUPABASE_SERVICE_KEY, otherwise 503 avatar_storage_unavailable.

item.name: 78. Avatars: back to the generated one
81. Assistant: how do I get this achievement?

request.description: Run 54 first (it saves an achievement id of the game in trackGameId). The first time it writes a new guide (counts towards your daily limit) and saves it for everyone; grounded tells whether it came from an approved wiki (see sources). spoilers=true is needed for hidden achievements. lang: two-letter code.

item.name: 82. Assistant: the same guide again (saved, free)

exec: pm.test("Served from the saved guide", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().saved).to.eql(true); });

request.description: Always a new answer (counts), never saved.

item.name: 85. Admin: set the game's reference wiki

request.description: Replace GAME with the game's wiki and CHECK ITS LICENSE first (the footer of a Fandom wiki says it). Forgets the game's saved guides so they are rewritten from the wiki.

item.name: 87. Admin: forget a game's saved guides
88. Admin: remove the game's reference wiki

request.description: Run 39 first (it saves a slug). The frontend's address is /games/{slug}.
Lists stored franchises the rules reject and why. Nothing is changed.
Removes the links listed by 90. Check 90's list first.

item.name: 92. Admin: block a creator as not a franchise

request.description: Set creatorId to an id from GET /api/creators?role=franchise. Removes its franchise links and future imports skip it.
achievementsUnlocked, averageCompletion (over games with at least one unlock; null if none), perfectGames, gamesOwned. Private, only for you.
Newest first, 1 to 20, with the game's slug and rarity.

item.name: 96. Admin: refresh a game's icons from Steam

request.description: Reads the achievement list from Steam again and updates our icons (served from the current Steam host).

item.name: 97. Admin: copy a game's icons into our storage

request.description: Needs the public bucket achievement-icons and SUPABASE_URL / SUPABASE_SERVICE_KEY. missingAchievementIds: icons Steam no longer has anywhere.

item.name: 98. Admin: serve a game's icons from Steam again

request.description: Deletes our copies.
Open chat about a game. The frontend keeps the conversation and sends it each time; nothing is stored. Counts towards the daily limit (not for admins).

item.name: 100. AI chat: follow-up with the conversation

request.description: The whole conversation, oldest first, ending with the new question. The last 12 messages are used.

item.name: 101. Admin: rewrite a guide with instructions

request.description: Saved as curated: served to everyone, never expires, never replaced automatically. Run 54 first (it saves guideAchievementId).

item.name: 102. Admin: save your own guide text

request.description: Markdown, up to 8000 characters. Keeps the previous guide's sources. Saved as curated.
The next request writes a new one (from the wiki if the game has one).
